# aidial_model (Resource)

Manages a model deployment in DIAL Core (`PUT /v1/models/{bucket}/{path}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aidial_bucket" "current" {}

resource "aidial_model" "example" {
  bucket          = data.aidial_bucket.current.bucket
  path            = "my-model"
  name            = "my-model"
  type            = "CHAT"
  display_name    = "My Model"
  display_version = "latest"
  description     = "Example chat model served through an OpenAI-compatible adapter."
  override_name   = "gpt-example"

  catalog_schema_id = "https://dial.epam.com/catalog-schemas/model"
  catalog_properties = {
    provider            = "Provider"
    vendor              = "Vendor"
    license             = "License"
    knowledgeCutoffDate = "2026-08-17"
    parameters          = "100B"
  }

  endpoint = "https://adapter.example.com/openai/deployments/gpt-example/chat/completions"

  input_attachment_types = ["image/*", "application/pdf"]
  description_keywords   = ["Text Generation", "Image Recognition"]
  user_roles             = ["default", "user"]

  features = {
    system_prompt_supported = true
    tools_supported         = true
    temperature_supported   = true
  }

  limits = {
    max_prompt_tokens     = 200000
    max_completion_tokens = 32000
  }

  pricing = {
    unit       = "token"
    prompt     = "0.000002"
    completion = "0.000008"
  }

  upstreams = [
    {
      id       = "primary"
      endpoint = "https://adapter-eu.example.com/openai/deployments/gpt-example/chat/completions"
      weight   = 1
      tier     = 0
    },
    {
      id       = "secondary"
      endpoint = "https://adapter-us.example.com/openai/deployments/gpt-example/chat/completions"
      weight   = 1
      tier     = 1
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Model name stored in the DIAL API request body.
- `type` (String) DIAL model type, for example CHAT.

### Optional

- `author` (String)
- `bucket` (String) Target DIAL bucket. Defaults to "platform" when not set.
- `catalog_properties` (Dynamic) Catalog metadata of the model (free-form object, sent to DIAL as `catalogProperties`), e.g. provider, vendor, license, knowledgeCutoffDate, parameters.
- `catalog_schema_id` (String) URI (`$id`) of the catalog schema describing `catalog_properties`, e.g. the `schema_id` of an `aidial_catalog_schema`.
- `default_headers` (Map of String)
- `defaults` (Dynamic) Default request parameters merged into every request to the model (free-form object, sent to DIAL as-is), e.g. max_tokens, custom_fields, tools.
- `dependencies` (Set of String)
- `description` (String) Model description.
- `description_keywords` (Set of String)
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable model name.
- `display_version` (String)
- `endpoint` (String) Model API endpoint.
- `features` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))
- `fields_hashing_order` (Set of String) Field paths used to compute a stable hash of the request body, for example for caching.
- `forward_auth_token` (Boolean)
- `icon_url` (String)
- `input_attachment_types` (Set of String)
- `interceptors` (Set of String)
- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--interfaces))
- `intro` (String)
- `limits` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `max_input_attachments` (Number) Maximum number of attachments in one request (maxInputAttachments in the API).
- `max_retry_attempts` (Number)
- `override_name` (String)
- `path` (String) Model path inside the target bucket. Defaults to name when not set.
- `pricing` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pricing))
- `reference` (String)
- `responses_endpoint` (String)
- `tokenizer_model` (String) Model whose tokenizer DIAL Core uses to count tokens for this model (tokenizerModel in the API), e.g. gpt-4-0314.
- `upstreams` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--upstreams))
- `user_roles` (Set of String) Roles allowed to use the model.

### Read-Only

- `api_name` (String) Canonical model name returned by the DIAL API.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Model status returned by the DIAL API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <bucket>/<path>.
terraform import aidial_model.example platform/my-model
```
